attempt_policy: One fixed run; errors retained; repairs versioned and explained; no parameter changes from favorable/unfavorable output

F01.hypothesis: Explicit identity plus publication/receipt/version gates preserve distinctions lost by the current MarketDataPoint fields.
F01.inputs: 4 fixed pairs: quote, payoff/settlement, chain token, venue; 2 clock failures; late revision before/after receipt; missing FX and explicit 0.97 conversion; invalid instrument control
F01.reference: actual installed MarketDataPoint field introspection; explicit expected pair labels; Decimal arithmetic; no independent human assessor
F01.metric: 0 collisions among 4 distinct identities; all invalid temporal/conversion inputs rejected; as-of old then revised record; currency amount 100 USDT ->97 USD only with observed FX
F01.reject: any identity collision, future revision or implicit FX acceptance
F01.inconclusive: provider metadata unsupported or unavailable; synthetic success never certifies true identity of market data

F02.hypothesis: An accessible separate archival route would corroborate the 38 fixed boundaries.
F02.inputs: existing protocol/result hashes and raw-directory inventory; no repeat calls absent evidence of changed access
F02.metric: new eligible successful receipt plus full38 comparison required
F02.success: all38 match with documented provenance; NOT expected to be testable offline
F02.inconclusive: no change of access or missing receipts
F02.budget: 0 new network calls; preserve original1-call timeout

F03.hypothesis: Existing retrospective panel can support a new PIT universe/ranking experiment without reconstructing eligibility from future knowledge.
F03.inputs: acquisition metadata for all pairs; deterministic schema samples BTCUSDT ETHUSDT FTTUSDT USDCUSDT if present; identity_events13 censored cases; only schema/provenance/dates, no return computation
F03.controls: synthetic universe with late listing, known delisting, revision and excluded USDC; oracle membership by explicit decisions; naive latest/current-survivor selection as negative control
F03.metric: 100% coverage of required temporal/eligibility evidence on used data; 0 synthetic membership mismatches
F03.success: gate passes only if all evidence exists and PIT is verified
F03.reject: reject this dataset use if future information required; do not reject residual ranking economically
F03.inconclusive: missing historical evidence/hedge cost/unused evaluation period; no IC/PnL then

F04.hypothesis: Partial second-leg fills and segregated cash can overturn apparent full-fill basis profit.
F04.inputs: 9 scenarios: future fill0,0.5,1 BTC times delay0,1,10 seconds; unwind spot prices100,99,95 tied exogenously to delay; spot buy1 BTC at100; future sell101; matched legs close at100; quote fee0.001 each fill
F04.capital: spot venue110 USD, future venue50 USD, margin20% of101*filled, no transfer; matched positions held86400seconds; no funding or interest in base scenario; sensitivity financing break-even reported not estimated
F04.reference: event ledger with Decimal versus independent closed-form Fraction cash flows; exact expected no-transfer rejection with future cash0 despite spot cash160
F04.metric: cash/PnL error<=1e-10; no negative free cash; no implicit cross-venue netting; payoff sign and delay sensitivity
F04.success: ledger matches all9 closed forms and rejects orphan/insufficient local margin controls
F04.reject: reject robustness of this synthetic gross-edge example when net<=0; any accounting mismatch rejects adapter correctness
F04.inconclusive: no real L2/latency/fees/funding/MTM liquidation path; no empirical fill rates/capacity

F05.hypothesis: Dependence and adaptive selection make naive intervals and selected single-test p-values too optimistic.
F05.inputs: AR(1) rho0.6,n160,stationary variance1,seed2026091105,400 series; circular block bootstrap length8,299 resamples; fixed95% intervals; exact Gaussian known-covariance reference; no market outcomes
F05.multiplicity: 8 blocks x4 fixed independent seeded Gaussian magnitudes (seed2026091106); enumerate all256 shared sign patterns; one-sided max-mean selection; exact unadjusted selected p versus maxT corrected p
F05.labels: 30 synthetic labels, row5 ends25, plus one late-available label; teststarts15,20,25; oracle requires label end and available before cutoff
F05.reference: analytic AR1 variance versus covariance matrix sum; loop versus vectorized sign randomization; scalar interval membership oracle
F05.metric: coverage counts with Monte Carlo SE; mean interval width; exact selected-family type-I fraction at0.05; 0 forbidden labels after gate
F05.success: known-variance95% coverage within0.90..0.99; exact maxT family rejection<=0.05; arithmetic references<=1e-10; all label controls pass
F05.reject: reject tested inferential procedure if coverage<0.90 or maxT error>0.05 under its stated null; do not tune blocklength afterward
F05.inconclusive: unknown market dependence; block8 may under-cover; no real complete search ledger/label manifest means no economic CI or SPA/PBO claim

preservation: No frozen hypotheses/outcomes updated; new research adapters only; no complete suite repeat
